description: 12 reusable scientific knowledge graph edge-case benchmark items covering JATS locators, metadata isolation, twin disambiguation, non-merge guardrails, epistemic auditing, conflict preservation, query drift, and honest degradation.

items.input_snippet: locator_scheme='jats_paragraph'; node evidence carries page_number=1 for paragraph sec2-p01.
items.rationale: JATS paragraph packages have no PDF pages; inventing page 1 violates locator integrity.

items.input_snippet: case.json root has doi='10.1000/p1'; secondary-material.json has no DOI in XML or manifest.
items.rationale: Root DOI/title/authors belong strictly to the primary paper and must never leak onto secondary.

items.input_snippet: Merge decision cites secondary-material.json and secondary-publisher.xml as 2-paper corroboration.
items.rationale: secondary-publisher.xml is a verification twin of secondary-material.json, not a second independent paper.

items.input_snippet: Primary uses 'control group' (saline, n=10); Secondary uses 'control group' (untreated cells, n=24).
items.rationale: Generic cohort/control/catalyst/CNN terms across papers cannot merge into one physical instance.

items.input_snippet: Primary defines 'Copper Metal-Organic Framework (Cu-MOF)'; Secondary defines 'Cu-MOF (Copper Metal-Organic Framework)'.
items.rationale: Independent matching expansions of a specific named framework justify a cross-paper merge decision.

items.input_snippet: Introduction: 'Prior work showed X promotes Y (Doe et al., 2020) [5].' Labeled epistemic_status='direct_experimental'.
items.rationale: Cited prior-art claims in Introduction cannot be labeled direct_experimental.

items.input_snippet: Quote: 'Serum level A correlated with score B (r=0.41).' Edge relation='causes'.
items.rationale: Associative/hedged evidence cannot be upgraded to strong causal predicates.

items.input_snippet: Primary: Catalyst C increases yield (85% at 298 K); Secondary: Catalyst C decreases yield (40% at 380 K).
items.rationale: Genuine scientific conflicts with condition qualifiers are preserved without averaging and do not downgrade status.

items.input_snippet: Query asks path from Material M through Method A to Metric P across 2 hops.
items.rationale: Multi-hop queries must traverse real assembled graph edges and attach per-hop provenance.

items.input_snippet: Query claims supporting edge E-999 which was removed or never existed in assembled_kg.json.
items.rationale: Answers citing non-existent graph IDs must be intercepted before final delivery.

items.input_snippet: Query requests raw supplementary clinical patient CSV or microscope pixel values absent from JATS text.
items.rationale: Missing supplementary/pixel/clinical data must return answer_status='unreported' without fabrication.

items.input_snippet: Scanned image-only PDF with 0 native characters and unavailable OCR produces unextractable_asset.
items.rationale: Unreadable PDF inputs must never fabricate graph facts and must force honest partial/failed status.
